Course 001: Finding Work-Life Balance

Private Preview Build: Review this version before adding it to the live Academy.

Before You Begin

This course is designed for educational and personal-growth purposes only.

The activities and questions are intended to encourage self-reflection, help participants develop practical life and employment skills, and support personal and vocational goals.

This course is not:

  • A psychological evaluation
  • A medical or mental-health assessment
  • A clinical screening tool
  • A diagnosis of any condition
  • A substitute for professional medical, mental-health, counseling, or emergency services

There are no right or wrong answers. Responses are for the participant’s own learning and growth.

If an activity raises concerns about physical health, mental health, emotional well-being, or safety, the participant should contact a qualified healthcare professional, counselor, case manager, or appropriate emergency service.

The purpose of this Academy is to provide practical education, strengthen personal and workplace skills, and support participants in achieving greater independence, employment readiness, and long-term success.

Anonymous workbook: This course does not request your name, email address, phone number, or other personal information. Your answers stay on your device unless you download your own workbook backup.

How to use the workbook

Save progress on this device: Keeps answers in the same browser on the same phone, tablet, or computer.

Download My Workbook: Creates an anonymous backup file in the device’s Downloads area.

Load My Workbook: Restores that backup later.

End-of-module review: Each module ends with a plain-language overview and practical recommendations. There is no certificate.

Shared-device reminder: Use “Start Fresh” before a different participant uses the same browser.
